login_methods.desc: Choose Overseas mobile, enter your number with country code, get the SMS code. Works for numbers from 220+ countries.
On the login page choose the passport option and photograph your passport photo page. No phone number needed.
Passport kiosks print a username and password, but at PVG they are past security in departures, not in arrivals.
